relations.text: DynatraceのプラットフォームはAWSなどのハイパースケーラーと提携・統合する。
relations.text_en: The Dynatrace platform partners and integrates with hyperscalers such as AWS.

source.label: Dynatrace 10-K
source.quote: The Dynatrace platform is built to scale, partnering and integrating seamlessly into hybrid, multicloud ecosystems, including major hyperscalers such as Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), Microsoft Azure (“Azure”), and Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”), as well as traditional on-premises and mainframe solutions.

relations.text: AWS、Azure、GCPにまたがるクラウドネイティブ連携を拡充した
relations.text_en: Dynatrace expanded cloud-native integrations across AWS, Azure and GCP

source.label: Dynatrace 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Expanded cloud-native integrations across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to give enterprises a unified view across multi‑cloud environments.

relations.text: Dynatraceは2024 Microsoft Americas Partner of the Year Awardsで受賞した

source.quote: In addition, Dynatrace was named a Winner in the 2024 Microsoft Americas Partner of the Year Awards for our ability to innovate and collaborate to foster customer success, AI and CoPilot activation, and transform businesses on the Microsoft Cloud.

relations.text: ServiceNowと自律的なIT運用に向けた複数年の戦略協業を発表した

source.label: Dynatrace 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced a multi-year strategic collaboration with ServiceNow to advance autonomous IT operations to empower customers to drive better outcomes, optimize services, and provide seamless digital experiences that drive customer and employee satisfaction.

relations.text: Dynatraceは、Atlassianと連携開発で提携する。

source.quote: We partner with leading innovative technology organizations such as Atlassian, Red Hat, ServiceNow, and VMware to develop integrations, best practices, and extended capabilities that help our customers and solution partners achieve faster time to market and enhanced value in dynamic multicloud environments.

relations.text: 本番環境の知見をインシデント管理に組み込むAtlassian連携を発表した

source.label: Dynatrace 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced an integration with Atlassian, embedding real-time production insights directly into incident management processes.

relations.text: NVIDIAのEnterprise AI Factoryと統合する新たな協業を発表した

source.quote: • Announced a new collaboration to integrate Dynatrace's full-stack, AI and LLM observability solution with NVIDIA’s Enterprise AI Factory, enabling customers to deploy their own AI factory with real-time observability and AI-powered insights.
